subject.title: fix(skills): list omitted skill names when prompt is truncated

question: Should omitted-skill lookup keys still be added on top of the merged identity-first compact skills rewrite, or should the remaining visibility work stay with the broader truncation issue?
rationale: Current main now solves a large part of the original prompt-overflow problem differently, but it still does not expose omitted keys when count or extreme char truncation occurs.

options.title: Port omitted-key recovery
options.body: Rebase the PR concept onto current main, keep the merged compact-description behavior, and require final-render budgeting plus exact-head proof before merge.

options.title: Close as superseded by compact identities
options.body: Treat the merged compact identity/description rewrite as sufficient for now and leave only broader priority or smart-loading work on the canonical issue.

options.title: Defer to skills policy design
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers decide the priority, pinning, or lazy-loading policy tracked by the related skills issues.

recommendation.title: Port omitted-key recovery
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR concept onto current main, keep the merged compact-description behavior, and require final-render budgeting plus exact-head proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent history across the skills prompt, docs, and config-adjacent surfaces affected by this decision.
